scope.purpose: Fresh blind semantic tie-break against the exact committed Phase-1 criterion; no per-paper artifact is modified.

provenance.independence_note: Freshness, persuasion blindness, and role separation do not establish an independent error process; same-family correlated error remains possible.

routing.rule_application: The first non-DA label is EIC, so the frozen EIC card supplies the verification persona.

items.change_summary: Relative to the original manuscript, patch operations 36 and 38 replace blocks B0087 and B0091 with a named comparator-class set, a project-specific synthesis statement, and explicit limits on global originality and priority claims.
evidence_anchor: text: papers/29-bianchi-ideal-owner-refinement/notes/stage4_revision_round1.tex:338, block B0087, Discussion and Implications — 'The bounded contribution is a project-specific synthesis of typed owner semantics, a literal-ideal stress test, fail-closed Gate-Q and Gate-M contracts, and an independent-replay specification.'

text: papers/29-bianchi-ideal-owner-refinement/notes/stage4_revision_round1.tex:338, block B0087, Discussion and Implications — 'Certificate methods, proof-carrying computation, and replay-oriented workflow design are therefore comparison classes rather than components claimed as new in isolation.'

text: papers/29-bianchi-ideal-owner-refinement/notes/stage4_revision_round1.tex:350, block B0091, Acknowledged Limitations — 'The contribution is therefore limited to the manuscript's project-specific synthesis and prospective specification; it is not a priority claim against all certificate-methods, proof-carrying computation, or arithmetic-dynamics workflows.'
change_evidence: papers/29-bianchi-ideal-owner-refinement/notes/stage4_revision_round1.tex.apply-report.json — op_index 36 and op_index 38 are recorded as applied

requirements.label: comparison_set_named
requirements.reason: B0087 names certificate methods, proof-carrying computation, and replay-oriented workflow design as the comparison classes.

requirements.label: distinct_unit_of_contribution_stated
requirements.reason: B0087 states the unit as a project-specific synthesis of four named architectural elements.

requirements.label: adaptations_versus_synthesis_labeled
requirements.reason: The revised text labels the aggregate as synthesis and says the comparator classes are not claimed as new in isolation, but it never identifies which manuscript elements are adaptations or otherwise maps adapted components against the claimed synthesis. Calling something a comparison class is not, by itself, the required adaptation label.

requirements.label: no_unsupported_global_novelty_claim
requirements.reason: B0087 disclaims a global originality claim and B0091 disclaims priority against all relevant workflows.

literal_quantifier_and_label_reasoning.closed_verdict_reason: Because the criterion is conjunctive, one incomplete required label prevents FULLY_ADDRESSED. The substantive comparator, contribution-unit, and novelty-boundary changes prevent NOT_ADDRESSED; no regression supports MADE_WORSE, and the evidence is directly inspectable, so CANNOT_VERIFY does not apply.

residual_gap.text: The contribution-positioning text must explicitly identify which inherited components or methods are adaptations and contrast those labeled adaptations with the project-specific synthesis; the current comparator-class wording does not perform that mapping.

distinct_issue_dissent_escalation_audit.reason: The missing adaptation-versus-synthesis mapping is a residual of REV-EIC-1 itself. The committed criterion is clear, feasible, and applicable, and the evidence raises no research-integrity, ethics, safety, legal-compliance, or fatal-validity exception.

routing.rule_application: The DA label parses successfully but DA is never a Phase 2A verification persona; with no non-DA source label, the protocol requires fallback routing to the frozen EIC card.

literal_quantifier_and_label_reasoning.criterion_shape: ANY_OF branch A or branch B; one whole branch must be satisfied

branches.label: A_synthetic_fixture
branches.reason: B0081 explicitly says the fixtures are specifications and not executed tests. It supplies neither a worked synthetic fixture nor an explicit simpler baseline and diagnostic outcome.

branches.label: B_prospective_organizational_benefit_only
branches.reason: B0081 and B0087 clearly disclaim demonstrated usefulness and performance, but unchanged B0084 still characterizes the literal codomain as 'scientifically useful as a stress test.' That is not a label limiting the claim to prospective organizational benefit.

literal_quantifier_and_label_reasoning.closed_verdict_reason: The disjunction is not satisfied because neither complete branch is present. Genuine narrowing and explicit non-result language make the response more than NOT_ADDRESSED; the unchanged scientific-usefulness claim leaves a concrete same-item residual, so PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED applies. There is no comparative degradation supporting MADE_WORSE, and the relevant text is directly inspectable.

residual_gap.text: Either add the committed worked synthetic fixture with an explicit simpler baseline and diagnostic outcome, or remove/qualify the remaining 'scientifically useful as a stress test' claim so that any usefulness statement is expressly only a prospective organizational benefit with no demonstrated scientific value.

distinct_issue_dissent_escalation_audit.reason: The unchanged scientific-usefulness sentence and absent worked fixture are direct residuals of REV-DA-2, not a distinct issue. The OR criterion is clear and feasible, and no protected escalation class is implicated.

routing.rule_application: The first non-DA label is R3, so the frozen interoperability/comparative R3 card supplies the verification persona.

literal_quantifier_and_label_reasoning.criterion_shape: FOR_EACH case in {valid, invalid}, ALL_OF private payload, common semantic mapping, adapter predicate, validator state transition, fail-closed result, and non-scientific/no-census boundary

cases.label: valid_BP_CP_case
cases.reason: The valid trace labels both private payload tags, maps both through adapters to common fields, names predicate dispatch, gives the declared-to-accepted state sequence, and explicitly disclaims scientific inputs, validator runs, and census outcomes.

cases.label: invalid_BP_CP_case
cases.reason: The invalid trace names one missing common field and one unknown proof-type value and gives fail-closed terminal dispositions, but it does not show each invalid producer's private payload/tag, its adapter-to-common mapping, its exact adapter predicate, and its full validator state transition. The paragraph's collective closing summary cannot discharge the committed word 'each.'

literal_quantifier_and_label_reasoning.closed_verdict_reason: Because the per-case quantifier fails for the invalid case, FULLY_ADDRESSED is unavailable. The newly inserted, detailed valid trace and partial invalid trace constitute genuine evidence, so NOT_ADDRESSED is too harsh; no regression supports MADE_WORSE, and the paragraph is directly inspectable.

residual_gap.text: For each invalid BP and CP example, show the private payload/tag, the adapter-to-common-field mapping, the exact failed adapter or checker predicate, and the validator's complete state transition to its fail-closed terminal result, while retaining the explicit non-scientific/no-census boundary.

distinct_issue_dissent_escalation_audit.reason: The abbreviated invalid trace is the unresolved portion of REV-P33-011 itself. The criterion is unambiguous and applicable to the inserted block, and the evidence raises no protected escalation class.

phase2a_sidecars.audit_summary: No distinct new issue, dissent, or escalation exception is warranted for any of the three scoped items; every identified gap remains traceable to its existing roadmap item.
